intended_object: The coordinate (Hopf) algebra of the closed upper-triangular (Borel) subgroup of GL_ι over a commutative ring K: K[x_ij, det⁻¹]/(x_ij : i > j). Inferred from the docstring, the module doc and the Milne 2.9 reference.
explanation: The GL coordinate ring here is Localization.Away of the determinant in the polynomial ring on ι×ι, with `matrix i j` the image of X_(i,j). `ideal` is spanned by `matrix i j` for j < i (the extra 0 generators are harmless), so the quotient is exactly K[x_ij, 1/det]/(x_ij, i>j). That is the standard coordinate ring of T_n. No diagonal relations are imposed, which is correct for the Borel subgroup. The file proves the ideal is a Hopf ideal, so the Hopf structure descends. The setting (commutative ring K, finite linearly ordered index type) is the natural one, since the order is needed to define "upper triangular". The only restriction is that ι and K share a universe, which is minor.
